audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race condition: currentSlot (L169) and now (L172) are sampled from time.Now() separately, creating inconsistent time snapshots during slot boundaries. When a slot transition occurs between these two calls, a data column with slot N+1 can pass validation because currentSlot=N (pre-boundary) while now is post-boundary, causing the earliestStart check to incorrectly pass.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends gossip data column sidecar with slot N+1 approximately 500ms before slot boundary. Due to processing delay, line 169 samples slot N (pre-boundary) but line 172 samples time post-boundary, causing the future slot validation to incorrectly pass and accept the sidecar.
